messages.author: 169a6d0bde33b5b5
messages.subject: Tesseract support on shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

There is a package named "tesseract" on cran that makes the necessary bindings to tesseract.
Currently it also has support to return the extracted info in hocr-format so it is possible to extract text from images including positional information of words and lines.

As I understand, it is not possible to install any additional packages on Ubuntu/Linux that shinyapps.io runs on (correct me if I'm wrong) but would it be possible to do an exception for some certain packages (like tesseract)? I think that this would give a lot of benefits for many people developing shiny apps to have ocr abilities out of the box.

Regards,
Robert
